parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the refrigerator, made of steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and shape.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is one of the refrigerator doors, made of stainless steel, providing access to the internal compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the refrigerator compartment to maintain internal temperature and prevent air leakage.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinge to open and close, allowing user access to the interior.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the second refrigerator door, also made of stainless steel, typically covering the freezer compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the freezer section and helps maintain its low temperature by sealing tightly.
parts.Movement_description: The door swings open and closed on its hinge, similar to the main refrigerator door.
